what: blaze-vfs has `Vfs::commit_owned(&mut self, head: &str, base: ContentId, ops: Vec<Op>) -> Result<Commit, CommitError>`, the same as `commit` but taking the ops by value so each write's bytes become the store's with no copy (commit copies each once). In crates/blaze-api/src/session.rs at the two `cx.vfs.commit(&head, base, &ops)` calls (about lines 474 and 532): where `ops` is not used after the call, write `cx.vfs.commit_owned(&head, base, ops)`. Same root, same rebase, same errors.

history.note: crates/blaze-api/src/session.rs: both commits (edit_ended, Request::Commit) call cx.vfs.commit_owned(&head, base, ops); ops was unused after each.
